fixtures.name: permit-any-tool
fixtures.description: A minimal permit over every tool is the smallest valid request-contract v1 policy.

fixtures.name: permit-exact-tool
fixtures.description: Resource scope may name one exact runtime tool.

fixtures.name: unsupported-tool-id
fixtures.description: A tool id no endpoint reports warns once per distinct id; catalogued ids stay silent.

fixtures.name: ask-annotated-permit
fixtures.description: ASK and description annotations are valid on permit policies.

fixtures.name: guarded-optional-context
fixtures.description: Optional context access is valid when a has-guard dominates every evaluation path.
fixtures.policyText:
@id("guarded-git")
permit(principal, action == Kontext::Action::"ToolUse", resource == Kontext::Tool::"Bash") when { context has command && context.command like "git*" };

fixtures.name: nested-context-guard
fixtures.description: Path-aware guards support nested context records.
fixtures.policyText:
@id("nested-guard")
permit(principal, action == Kontext::Action::"ToolUse", resource) when { context has repository && context.repository has owner && context.repository.owner == "kontext-security" };

fixtures.name: fail-closed-forbid
fixtures.description: A forbid reading optional context is valid when it explicitly matches the absent case.
fixtures.policyText:
@id("forbid-curl")
forbid(principal, action == Kontext::Action::"ToolUse", resource == Kontext::Tool::"Bash") when { !(context has command) || (context has command && context.command like "curl*") };

fixtures.name: multi-policy-set
fixtures.description: A set combining permit and fail-closed forbid policies with distinct ids is valid.

fixtures.name: invalid-utf8
fixtures.description: Policy text containing an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate is rejected before parsing.

fixtures.name: policy-too-large
fixtures.description: Policy text above the byte ceiling is rejected before parsing.

fixtures.name: parse-error
fixtures.description: Text that is not a Cedar policy set is rejected.

fixtures.name: too-many-policies
fixtures.description: A policy set above the policy-count ceiling is rejected before per-policy analysis.

fixtures.name: policy-too-complex
fixtures.description: A policy above the AST node or depth ceiling is rejected before recursive analysis.

fixtures.name: templates-unsupported
fixtures.description: Policy templates and slots are outside request-contract v1.

fixtures.name: missing-policy-id
fixtures.description: Every policy requires a stable @id annotation.

fixtures.name: invalid-policy-id
fixtures.description: Policy ids must be 1-128 portable identifier characters starting alphanumerically.

fixtures.name: duplicate-policy-id
fixtures.description: Policy ids must be unique across the set.

fixtures.name: unsupported-annotation
fixtures.description: Annotations outside the id/description/ask vocabulary are rejected.

fixtures.name: unsupported-ask-value
fixtures.description: The ask annotation accepts only the literal prompt value.

fixtures.name: ask-on-forbid
fixtures.description: ASK annotations are valid only on permit policies.

fixtures.name: unsupported-entity-scope
fixtures.description: Entity types outside the request-contract v1 vocabulary are rejected.

fixtures.name: unsupported-action-scope
fixtures.description: The only action in request-contract v1 is ToolUse.

fixtures.name: principal-policy-scope
fixtures.description: Principal-bound scopes are rejected while identity is descriptive.

fixtures.name: principal-policy-condition
fixtures.description: Principal references in conditions are rejected while identity is descriptive.
fixtures.policyText:
@id("principal-attr")
permit(principal, action == Kontext::Action::"ToolUse", resource) when { principal.department == "engineering" };

fixtures.name: unguarded-optional-context
fixtures.description: Optional context access without a dominating has-guard is rejected.
fixtures.policyText:
@id("unguarded")
permit(principal, action == Kontext::Action::"ToolUse", resource) when { context.command == "pwd" };

fixtures.name: forbid-may-fail-open
fixtures.description: A forbid reading optional context without matching its absence can fail open and is rejected.
fixtures.policyText:
@id("fail-open")
forbid(principal, action == Kontext::Action::"ToolUse", resource) when { context has command && context.command == "rm -rf /" };

fixtures.name: corpus-evaluation-error
fixtures.description: A policy that errors against the smoke request corpus is rejected.
fixtures.policyText:
@id("type-confused")
permit(principal, action == Kontext::Action::"ToolUse", resource) when { context has command && context.command > 5 };
